channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.28
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0-beta.28
Build 42. Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
The app retains the established local code-signing certificate and Sparkle EdDSA key for beta updates. It has no Developer ID signature or Apple notarization. First installation on another Mac may be blocked by Gatekeeper. This release does not require changing system security settings.
- New notes workspace with a searchable recording library, summary/transcript tabs, source navigation and compact-window layout. The previous layout remains available. - Notes use the selected app palette, including Refined light/dark colors. - Separate transcription and summary model selection. Replacement transcription is checkpointed without erasing the previous readable result. Previous results are backed up before replacement; explicit summary regeneration uses a fresh cache identity. - More resilient insertion when an editor recreates its accessibility object. A replacement must match the original window, unchanged input context and editor anchor. - Prefer the app’s native Paste menu. Use private keyboard events addressed to the target process when no menu action is available. Stale global modifier flags no longer veto delivery. - Never automatically repeat an ambiguous paste. Unconfirmed text has separate private recovery copies under Latest text, so subsequent dictation does not overwrite it. - Key unlock is read-only and caches the key for the session. It no longer immediately requests an ACL rewrite. Key operations require a persistent app signature; packaging rejects ad-hoc signing.
The package uses the established signing identity. macOS owns the Allow/Always Allow decision; passwords are entered only in the system dialog. No Keychain permissions are weakened.
## Verification
120 automated checks, 761 localized strings, 19 distribution guards and five prepared-release guards passed. Native insertion checks covered 24 consecutive insertions, UTF-16 selection, recreated editors, rejection of a different destination, targeted keyboard delivery and a delayed paste without duplication. Ten native UI renders covered both palettes and model options.
Insertion checks used a synthetic editor. Live dictation into Codex and broad third-party editor acceptance still require real-world verification. AI summaries remain drafts that should be checked against their source quotes.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.26
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 26
Build 40. Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
The app retains the established local code-signing certificate and Sparkle EdDSA key for beta updates. It has no Developer ID signature or Apple notarization. First installation on another Mac may be blocked by Gatekeeper. No system security settings need to be disabled for this release workflow.
- Adds a separate Meeting notes page: microphone plus optional meeting-app audio, local transcription, resumable segments, Markdown and WAV export. Fixes early interruption when the selected meeting app is silent; microphone recording continues and preserves timeline gaps. - Includes the opt-in compatibility paste mode for apps whose text editors are hidden from macOS Accessibility. Target/window checks and one automatic paste remain in place. Unconfirmed insertion keeps text recoverable; repeated cross-app paste still needs real-world acceptance. - Adds Parakeet Ultra for local multilingual transcription, including Ukrainian. Existing v3 and Whisper models remain available; no model is silently replaced. - Adds optional local Ukrainian meeting summaries with Qwen3.5 4B, Gemma 4 E4B QAT and Lapa 12B v0.1.2 GGUF. Downloaded weights are pinned and verified. The bundled llama.cpp worker receives text through stdin, runs with network access denied and has no cloud fallback. - Summaries separate completed work, decisions, agreed tasks, proposals, important points and open questions. Every item retains a checked source quote and approximate timestamp. Unverified owner/deadline text is omitted rather than presented as an agreement. AI classification still requires user review. - Long transcripts use bounded chunks, saved checkpoints and hierarchical overview reduction. Pause keeps the transcript, prior summary and completed parts. Markdown exports preserve prior user files. - Updates FluidAudio to 0.17.7 and corresponding dependency notices. Adds synthetic Ukrainian summary comparisons and public Ukrainian ASR fixtures without accessing private meeting transcripts or Gemini.
Me / Meeting audio remain recording channel labels, not speaker identities. Real 30–60 minute capture, diarization and varied Ukrainian meeting accuracy require separate acceptance. The one-hour journal/export regression is an accelerated file-storage check, not a physical recording test.
## Українською
Додано запис зустрічей, локальний текст і підсумки українською. У «Нотатки зустрічі» після зупинки запису натисніть «Розпізнати локально», потім «Створити локальний підсумок». Gemma 4 E4B, Qwen3.5 4B і Lapa 12B завантажуються окремо; підсумовування працює на Mac без надсилання транскрипції на сервер. Перевіряйте AI-чернетку, особливо рішення, виконавців і строки.
Це експериментальна бета без Developer ID та нотаризації Apple. Оновлення підписано ключем Sparkle. Свіже встановлення на іншому Mac може потребувати окремого дозволу macOS. Підтримуються Apple Silicon і macOS 14+, захоплення звуку застосунку потребує macOS 14.2+.
## Verification
110 automated checks and 664 localized strings passed. Local Ukrainian model probes and a two-part summary/Markdown probe passed; cancellation preserves the original transcript. These short synthetic checks do not establish complete AI accuracy or uninterrupted hour-long physical capture.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.23
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 23
- Fixes editor discovery when an application reports its window or a container as focused. Capture and pre-paste verification now resolve the focused editor consistently inside the original window. - Gives focused-editor discovery its own time budget so scanning a large message list for selected text cannot exhaust it. Keeps the initial focus identity before recording and tolerates an initially unavailable Accessibility window appearing during warm-up, while retaining window and user-input guards. - Adds capture and insertion failure details under Latest text → Focus diagnostics. Diagnostics omit field values, selected text, keystrokes and clipboard contents. Unconfirmed insertion continues to preserve the transcript for recovery. - Removes the old product name from visible instructions and nonessential internal names. Existing signing, permission, Keychain and legacy data identifiers remain compatible; fresh installations create a Pysano signing identity.
## Українською
Виправлено пошук поля введення та перевірку фокусу перед вставленням готової транскрипції. Великі списки повідомлень більше не витрачають час, відведений на пошук поля. У «Останній текст → Діагностика поля введення» доступна конкретна причина відмови без вмісту поля або буфера обміну. Стару назву прибрано з інтерфейсу; сумісність із наявними дозволами, ключем і моделями збережено.
## Verification
100 automated checks, application compilation and 572 localized strings passed validation. Focus regressions cover structural window/container traversal, rejecting unfocused editors, and bounded search. Repeated live dictation and actual paste delivery in Telegram, Codex and browser chats still require acceptance testing; this beta does not claim the intermittent insertion problem is eliminated in every application.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
